senses.gloss: 1. मुर् (fr. √ मुर्छ्), Pāṇ. vi, 4, 21, Sch.
3. मुर् cl. 6. P. मुरति, to encompass, entwine, bind together, Dhātup. xxviii, 53.
4. मु॑र् m. (prob. fr. √ मॄ; cf. आ-मुर्, अभि-प्र-मुर्) a destroyer, slayer, enemy, RV. viii, 55, 2 (Sāy. ‘a mortal’, others ‘a wall’).
1. मुर n. encompassing, surrounding, L.
2. मुर m. N. of a Daitya slain by Kṛṣṇa, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP. (cf. मुरु)
मुर n. See under 1. मुर.
मुरा f. See 2. मुर.
मुरा f. a species of fragrant plant (named after the Daitya), Bhpr.
said to be the N. of the wife of Nanda and mother of Candragupta, VP.
1. मूर॑ mf(आ)n. (either = मूढ or fr. √ मॄ) dull, stupid, foolish, RV.; PañcavBr.
2. मूर॑ mfn. (fr. √ 1. मू = मीव्) rushing, impetuous (said of Indra's horses), RV. iii, 43, 6 (Sāy. = मारक).
3. मू॑र n. (prob. also fr. √ 1. मू and meaning ‘something firm and fixed’, cf. Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 18) = मूल, a root, AV. i, 28, 3.
मुर—गण्ड m. an eruption on the face, L. (v.l. -मण्ड).
मुर—जित् m. ‘conqueror of Mura’, N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुर—द m. ‘Mura-slaying’, the discus of Viṣṇu, W.
मुराद m. = مراد, N. of a man, ib.
मुर—द्विष् m. ‘foe of Mura’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Inscr.
मुर—भिद् m. ‘slayer or foe of M˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुर—मर्दन m. ‘slayer or foe of M˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुर—रिपु m. ‘slayer or foe of M˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुर—वैरिन् m. ‘slayer or foe of M˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुर—हन् m. ‘slayer or foe of M˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, or Viṣṇu, Kāv.
मुरारि m. ‘enemy of Mura’, N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, Kāv.; Pur.; Kathās.
N. of the author of the Murāri-nāṭaka or Anargha-rāghava
of a Sch. on the Kātantra grammar and other authors &c. (also with पाठक, भट्ट, मिश्र &c.), Cat.
मुरारि—गुप्त m. N. of a disciple of Caitanya, Cat.
मुरारि—नाटक n. Murāri's drama i.e. Anargha-rāghava (-व्याख्या, f. and -व्याख्या-पूर्ण-सरस्वती f. N. of Comms. on it)
मुरारि—नाटक—व्याख्या f. N. of Comm. on Murāri's drama
मुरारि—नाटक—व्याख्या-पूर्ण-सरस्वती f. N. of Comm. on Murāri's drama
मुरारि—मिश्रीय n. N. of wk.
मुरारि—विजय n. N. of a drama by Kṛṣṇa-kavi (son of Nṛ-siṃha)
मुरारि—श्री-पति m. (with सावभौम) N. of an author, Cat.
मुरङ्गी f. Moringa Pterygosperma, Suśr. (v.l. मुरुङ्गी).
मुरची f. N. of a river, Ragh. (v.l.)
मुरची—पत्तन n. N. of a town in the Dekhan (also called मरीचि-पत्तन).
मुरज m. (fr. मुर + ज?) a kind of drum, tambourine (ifc. f(आ). ), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a Śloka artificially arranged in the form of a drum, Sāh. (also -बन्ध, Kpr.)
मुरजा f. a great drum, L.
N. of Kubera's wife, L.
मुरज—ध्वनि m. the sound of a drum, L.
मुरज—फल m. Artocarpus Integrifolia, L.
मुरज—बन्ध See above.
मुरजक m. N. of one of Śiva's attendants, Kathās.
मुरण्ड m. a country to the northwest of Hindūstān (also called Lampāka, and now Lamghan in Cabul), L.
pl. N. of a people (cf. मुरुण्ड).
मुरन्दला f. N. of a river, L. (= मुरला; thought by some to be Narma-dā).
मुरमण्ड See मुर-गण्ड.
मुरल m. (prob. fr. √ 3. मुर्) a species of fresh-water fish, Suśr.
a king of the Muralas, Inscr.
pl. N. of a people, Kathās.
मुरला f. N. of a river in the country of the Keralas (= मुरन्दला, L.), Ragh. (v.l. मुरची), Uttarar.
मुरली f. See below.
मुरली f. a flute, pipe, L.
मुरलिका f. N. of a woman, Vās., Introd.
मुरली—धर m. ‘flute-bearer’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, L.
of a grandson of Kālidāsa Miśra, Cat.
मुरली—प्रकाश m. ‘instruction in flute-playing’, N. of wk.
मुरवार m. N. of a king of the Turuṣkas, Kathās.
मुरसिदाबाद = مرشد آباد Murshidabad, N. of a city, Kṣitīś.
मुरु m. N. of a country, MBh.
of a Daitya (= मुर), MBh. (C. मरु), Hariv.; VP.
a species of plant (in explanation of मौर्वी), PārGṛ., Sch.
a kind of iron, L.
मुरु f. (in music) a kind of dance, Saṃgīt.
मूरु N. of a country, Col.
मुरु—देश m. N. of a country, Cat. (cf. मरु-द्˚).
मुरुङ्गी f. Moringa Pterygosperma, Suśr. (cf. मुरङ्गी).
मुरुण्टक m. pl. N. of a school, Buddh.
मुरुण्ड m. N. of a king, Vās., Introd.
pl. N. of a dynasty and a people (cf. Gk. Μαροῦνδαι, in Ptolemy), VP. (v.l. मुरूण्ड).
मुरूण्ड v.l. for मुरुण्ड.
मुरुण्डक m. N. of a mountain in Udyāna, Buddh.
मुरुताण-देश m. N. of a country, Cat.
मूर्ख॑ mf(आ॑)n. stupid, foolish, silly, dull, TS.; Mn. &c.
inexperienced in (loc.), Kathās.
= गयत्री-रहित or सार्थ-गायत्री-रहित, L.
मूर्ख॑ m. a fool, blockhead, Bhartṛ.
Phaseolus Radiatus, L.
N. of a poet, Cat.
मूर्ख &c. See p. 823, col. 3.
मूर्ख—ता f.
मूर्ख—त्व n. stupidity, foolishness, dulness, Kāv.; Pañcat.
मूर्ख—पण्डित m. a learned fool, Pañcat.
मूर्ख—भूय n. stupidity, L.
मूर्ख—भ्रातृक mfn. one who has a foolish brother, Pāṇ. v, 4, 157, Sch.
मूर्ख—मण्डल n. a collection or assemblage of fools, Pañcat.
मूर्ख—व्यसनि-नायक mfn. having a foolish and vicious commander, MW.
मूर्ख—शत n. a hundred fools, Hit.
मूर्ख—शतक n. N. of a Kāvya.
मूर्ख—हा (?) f. N. of a treatise on Prāyaścitta.
मूर्खिमन् m. dulness, stupidity, folly g. दृढादि.
मूर्खी-√ भू P. -भवति, to become stupid or foolish, Kathās.
मूर्छन mfn. stupefying, causing insensibility (applied to one of the 5 arrows of Kāma-deva), R.
(ifc.) strengthening, augmenting, confirming, Pañcar.
मूर्छन n. (mc.) and f(आ). fainting, swooning, syncope, Suśr.; Kir., Sch.
मूर्छन n. (in music) modulation, melody, a regulated rise or fall of sounds through the Grāma or musical scale (ifc. f(आ). ), Kāv.; Pur.; Saṃgīt.
मूर्छन n. vehemence, violence, prevalence, growth, increase (of diseases, fire &c.), MBh.
मूर्छन n. (also f(आ). ) a partic. process in metallic preparations, calcining quicksilver with sulphur, Bhpr.; Rasar.
मूर्छन See p. 823, col. 3.
मूर्छा f. fainting, a swoon, stupor, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
mental stupefaction, infatuation, delusion, hallucination, Kāv.; Sarvad.
congealment, solidification (of quicksilver), Kāv.
modulation, melody (= मूर्छना), Śiś., Sch.
मूर्छा˚क्षेप (˚छाक्ष्˚) m. (in rhet.) expression of vehement dissent or disapprobation by swooning, Kāvyād. ii, 155.
मूर्छापगम (˚छाप्˚) m. the passing off of faintness, Ragh.
मूर्छा—परिप्लुत mfn. overcome with faintness, insensible, MārkP.
मूर्छा—परीत mfn. id., MBh.
मूर्छा—प्रद mfn. causing faintness, MārkP.
मूर्छा—मय mf(ई)n. swoon-like, Naiṣ.
मूर्छा—वत् mfn. suffering from faintness, swooning away, W.
मूर्छाय m. faintness, a swoon, Car.
मूर्छाल m. fainted, insensible, L.
liable to faint or swoon away, Bhpr.
मूर्छित mfn. fainted, stupefied, insensible (n. impers.), MBh.; Kāv. &c. calcined, solidified (said of quicksilver), Sarvad.
intensified, augmented increased, grown, swollen (ifc. = filled or pervaded or mixed with), MBh.; Kāv.; Suśr.
tall, lofty, W.
reflected (as rays), Var.
agitated, excited, MBh.
मूर्छित n. a kind of song or air, BhP.
मूर्त॑ mfn. coagulated, TS.
settled into any fixed shape, formed, substantial, material, embodied, incarnate, ŚBr. &c. &c.
real (said of the division of time in practical use, as opp. to अ-मूर्त), Sūryas. (IW. 177)
stupefied, unconscious, insensible, Ragh.
मूर्त , मूर्ति. See p. 824, col. 1.
मूर्त—त्व n. material form, incarnate existence, Bhāṣāp.; MārkP.
मूर्त—त्व—जाति-निराकरण n. N. of wk.
मूर्त—मात्र n. that which is merely material, MW.
मूर्तय m. N. of a son of Kuśa, BhP.
मू॑र्ति f. any solid body or material form, (pl. material elements, solid particles; ifc. = consisting or formed of), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
embodiment, manifestation, incarnation, personification, TBr.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (esp. of Śiva, Hcat.)
anything which has definite shape or limits (in phil. as mind and the 4 elements earth, air, fire, water, but not आकाश, ether, IW. 52 n. 1), a person, form, figure, appearance, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
an image, idol, statue, Kāv.
beauty, Pañcat.
N. of the first astrological house, VarBṛS.
of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma, BhP.
मू॑र्ति m. N. of a Ṛṣi under the 10th Manu, ib.
of a son of Vasiṣṭha, VP.
मूर्ति—तस् ind. from the form, in bodily shape.
मूर्ति—त्व n. the having a body, corporeal nature, materiality, Sūryas.; VarBṛS.
(in phil.) she having a finite or fixed measure or motion.
मूर्ति—धर mfn. having a body, corporeal, incarnate, Kathās.; BhP.
मूर्ति—ध्यान n. N. of two works.
मूर्ति—प m. ‘image-keeper’, a priest who guards an idol, Cat.
मूर्ति—पूजा f. adoration of images, RTL. 524.
मूर्ति—प्रतिष्ठा f. N. of wk.
मूर्ति—प्रतिष्ठापन n. ‘setting up of idols’, N. of wk.
मूर्ति—भाव m. the state of assuming form, materiality, Dhātup.
मूर्ति—मत् mfn. having a material form (ifc. = formed of), corporeal, incarnate, personified, Mn.; MBh. &c.
मूर्ति—मय mf(ई). possessing a partic. form (with gen. = poss˚ the form of), Hariv.
मूर्ति—मात्रा f. a particle of matter, MW.
मूर्ति—लक्षण n. N. of wk.
मूर्ति—लिङ्ग n. (prob.) = प्राग्-ज्योतिष N. of the city of Naraka, Hariv.
मूर्ति—विघ्नेश m. pl. the eight manifestations of Śiva and the various Gaṇeśas (with मन्त्राः, the verses or formulas addressed to them), Hcat.
मूर्ति-संचर mfn. going about with a body, embodied, incarnate, Uttarar.
मूर्ति—संचार mfn. = -धर, Mcar.
मूर्ति—सनाथ mfn. (ifc.) possessing an idol of Kathās.
मूर्ति—सेवन n. (ifc.) worship of the idol of Dhūrtas.
मुर्भिणी f. a chafing-dish, fire-pan, L.
मु॑र्मुर m. (onomat.) an expiring ember, MaitrS.
burning chaff, Kāv. (v.l. मुर्मर)
the smell of the urine of a cow (mfn. smelling like the urine of a cow), L.
the god of love, L.
N. of one of the horses of the Sun, L.
मु॑र्मुरा (आ), f. N. of a river, MBh.
मुर्मुरीय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. prec.), Pat.
मुर्व् cl. 1. P. मूर्वति, to bind, tie, Dhātup. xv, 66 (cf. मूर्वा).
मू॑र—देव (मू॑र-), m. pl. N. of a class of demons, RV. (accord. to Sāy. fr. 2. मूर = मारण-क्रीड).
मूर्खलिका f. an arrow in the form of a bird's heart, L.
मूर्ण See under √ मॄ, p. 831, col. 2.
मूर्ण॑ mfn. crushed, broken, AV.; Br.
= मूत, bound, tied, L.
मूर्त्सा f. = मूस्छा, fainting away, Gal.

मूर्ध॑न् m. (Uṇ. i, 158) the forehead, head in general, skull, (fig.) the highest or first part of anything, top, point, summit, front (of battle), commencement, beginning, first, chief (applied to persons), RV. &c., &c., (मूर्ध्नि with √ वृत् &c., to be above everything, prevail; with √ धृ, or आ-√ दा = मूर्ध्ना √ 1. कृ, to place on the head, hold in high honour)
the base (in geom.; opp. to अग्र; perhaps w.r. for बुध्न), Col.
(in gram.) the roof or top of the palate (as one of the 8 Sthānas or places of utterance), Pāṇ. i, 1, 9, Sch.
(with Buddhists) ‘the summit’, N. of a state of spiritual exaltation, Divyāv.
मूर्धन्—व॑त् mfn. containing the word मूर्धन्, TS.; ŚBr.
मूर्धन्—व॑त् m. N. of a Gandharva, TĀr.
of an Āṅgirasa or Vāmadevya (author of RV. x, 88), RVAnukr.
1. मूर्ध in comp. for मूर्धन्.
2. मूर्ध (ifc.) = मूर्धन् the head (cf. द्वि and त्रि-मूर्ध).
मूर्ध—कर्णी f.
मूर्ध—कर्परी f.
मूर्ध—खोल n. a broad-brimmed hat or an umbrella, L.
मूर्ध—ग mfn. sitting down on a person's head, Kāv.
मूर्ध—गत m. N. of a Cakra-vartin, Divyāv.
मूर्धागत n. a partic. state of ecstasy, Divyāv.
मूर्ध—ज m. pl. ‘head-born’, the hair of the h˚, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the mane, Kathās.
N. of a Cakravartin, Buddh.
मूर्ध—ज्योतिस् n. = ब्रह्म-रन्ध्र, Cat.
मूर्ध—त॑स् ind. out of the head, on, the h˚, MaitrS.; AV.
मूर्ध—तैलिक (with वस्ति) m. N. of a kind of Errhine or remedy for promoting discharges from the nose, Suśr.
मूर्ध—धर mf(आ)n. supporting the head
मूर्ध—धरा f. (with सिरा) a vessel or vein which terminates in the head, Bhpr.
मूर्ध—पात m. splitting of the skull, Jyot.
मूर्ध—पिण्ड m. the lump on the head (of an elephant in rut), L.
मूर्ध—पुष्प m. Acacia Sirissa, L.
मूर्ध॑—भिन्न (मूर्ध॑-), mfn. one who has his head cleft, Suparṇ.
मूर्ध—रस m. the scum of boiled rice, L.
मूर्ध—वेष्टन n. ‘h˚-covering’, a turban, diadem, L.
मूर्ध—संहित॑ mf(आ)n. attached or fastened to the h˚, ŚBr.
मूर्धान्त m. the crown of the head, Kathās.
मूर्धाभिषिक्त mfn. having the head sprinkled, anointed, consecrated, MBh.
universally, acknowledged (as a rule or example), Pat.
मूर्धाभिषिक्त m. a consecrated king, Kāv.; Pur.
a man of the Kṣatriya or warrior caste, L.
a royal counsellor, minister, L.
a partic. mixed caste (= मूर्धावसिक्त), Yājñ. (v.l.)

a consecrated king, L.
an officer in the army (or ‘expert in the Dhanur-veda’, or ‘one who carries arms, or know, the power of precious stones, Mantras, and medicinal herbs’), L.
मूर्धक m. a Kṣatriya, L.

highest, uppermost, pre-eminent, Inscr.
मूर्धन्या f. N. of the mother of Veda-śiras, VP.
